targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDate(created_utc) AS time, 'MAE' AS metric, avg(JSONExtractFloat(metrics_json, 'mae')) AS value
FROM algo.experiment_runs FINAL
WHERE area = '${area}'
  AND metrics_json != '{}'
  AND created_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY time
UNION ALL
SELECT toDate(created_utc) AS time, 'RMSE' AS metric, avg(JSONExtractFloat(metrics_json, 'rmse')) AS value
FROM algo.experiment_runs FINAL
WHERE area = '${area}'
  AND metrics_json != '{}'
  AND created_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY time
UNION ALL
SELECT toDate(created_utc) AS time, 'sMAPE' AS metric, avg(JSONExtractFloat(metrics_json, 'smape')) AS value
FROM algo.experiment_runs FINAL
WHERE area = '${area}'
  AND metrics_json != '{}'
  AND created_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time, metric

SELECT ep.timestamp_utc AS time, 'Actual' AS metric, any(ep.actual) AS value
FROM algo.experiment_predictions AS ep FINAL
INNER JOIN algo.experiment_runs AS er FINAL ON ep.run_id = er.run_id
WHERE er.area = '${area}'
  AND toDate(ep.timestamp_utc) = toDate('${forecast_date}')
GROUP BY time
UNION ALL
SELECT ep.timestamp_utc AS time, 'Predicted' AS metric, any(ep.predicted) AS value
FROM algo.experiment_predictions AS ep FINAL
INNER JOIN algo.experiment_runs AS er FINAL ON ep.run_id = er.run_id
WHERE er.area = '${area}'
  AND toDate(ep.timestamp_utc) = toDate('${forecast_date}')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time, metric

SELECT toDate(created_utc) AS time, count() AS daily_runs
FROM algo.experiment_runs FINAL
WHERE area = '${area}'
  AND created_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT created_utc AS time, drift_score, drift_threshold
FROM algo.drift_reports FINAL
WHERE area = '${area}'
  AND created_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
ORDER BY created_utc

panels.title: Price Drift Score (last 30 days)
panels.description: Daily drift score comparing the last 7 days of day-ahead prices to the prior 90 days, via Evidently's DataDriftPreset. The statistical test (K-S p-value for small samples, Wasserstein distance for large) is auto-selected by Evidently — see the stat_test column in algo.drift_reports. Drift is flagged when drift_detected=1; the dashed red line marks the test's own threshold.
